name: birdsight
title_zh: 把观鸟照片变成带行为注释的物种档案
tagline_zh: 拍了一堆鸟图却认不全？它能按羽色、姿态、生境反查物种，并补上求偶、育雏等行为标签，让每张照片都成为可检索的观察记录。
tagline_en: Got bird photos but can't ID them? It cross-references plumage, posture, and habitat to name the species and tag.
why_zh: 不是简单识图——它把视觉特征与鸟类行为学数据库对齐，按观察场景输出带置信度的物种+行为双标签。
why_en: Not just image recognition—it aligns visual cues with an ethology database, outputting species + behavior tags with confidence.
limit_zh: 只认清晰单鸟主体照片；遮挡超30%、逆光或幼鸟羽色未定型时直接拒答。行为标签仅覆盖求偶、育雏、捕食、理羽四类。
limit_en: Only works on clear single-bird photos; rejects >30% occlusion, backlight, or juvenile plumage. Behavior tags limited to courtship, nesting.
